name: Gravel V3 2024
summary: Older press-fit Gravel V3 generation sold with mechanical RS/Sensah 2×12, full-hydraulic brakes, and separate 38 mm alloy or 50 mm wave-carbon wheel packages. Keep it distinct from later T47 V3 builds that reuse the same model name.

size_grid_conflict: Older product material and the size-51 configuration indicate 45 / 48 / 51 / 54.
The visible Taobao selector transcription says 45 / 48 / 50 / 54.

tire_clearance.note: The listing specifies a stock 700×40C tire but does not establish a dependable maximum clearance. The conflicting reused page graphics also prevent transferring a later V3 clearance claim.
